title: NOIR
shortDescription: AI-powered autonomous reliability engineering platform for intermittent failure discovery.
fullDescription: NOIR is an intelligent software reliability platform that autonomously discovers, reproduces, explains, and minimizes intermittent software failures in distributed systems. It combines fault injection, AI-driven experiment planning, observability, and reliability-aware trigger minimization to help developers identify complex failure conditions and generate reproducible regression scenarios.
role: AI Systems Architect & Full Stack Engineer
